episodes.name: The Party
episodes.overviewEn: After a fraternity hazing, Spider-Man must battle an old friend.

episodes.name: Sword of Shikata
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man must battle a warrior consumed with honor.

episodes.name: Law of the Jungle
episodes.overviewEn: Peter discovers his mentor has become the vengeful Lizard.

episodes.name: Keeping Secrets
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man is out to catch Talon, a female thief who is responsible for high-risk robberies in the city. Things get complicated when Spidey finds out that Talon is his best friend Harry's new girlfriend.

episodes.name: Tight Squeeze
episodes.overviewEn: A television station is taken hostage by ex-KGB agents.

episodes.name: Head Over Heels
episodes.overviewEn: An amateur inventor is determined to make Spider-Man her soul-mate.

episodes.name: When Sparks Fly
episodes.overviewEn: Electro tries to convert Sally into pure energy.

episodes.name: Spider-Man Dis-Sabled
episodes.overviewEn: An assassin targets Peter after an attempt on the Mayor's life.

episodes.name: Royal Scam
episodes.overviewEn: Kingpin tricks Spider-Man into performing a high-profile robbery.

episodes.name: Heroes and Villains
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man battles Turbo Jet, a modern-day Robin Hood armed with a homemade propulsion system, who steals from the wealthy and gives to the poor. Spidey's life gets even harder as the public rallies around Turbo Jet – and against Spider-Man.

episodes.name: Flash Memory
episodes.overviewEn: Peter's old rival, Flash Thompson, develops a super-intellect.

episodes.name: Mind Games (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man becomes the instrument of the Gaines Twins' revenge.

episodes.name: Mind Games (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man realizes he has been brainwashed.
